title: pace-code-e.pdf — section 15
text:
4.16 When recording media is removed from the recorder during the interview, they shall
be retained and the procedures in paragraph 4.18 followed. [This paragraph does
not apply to interviews recorded using a secure digital network as this does not use
removable media, see 1.6(c), 7.4 and 7.14 to 7.15.]
(i) Conclusion of interview

4.17 At the conclusion of the interview, the suspect shall be offered the opportunity to
clarify anything he or she has said and asked if there is anything they want to add.

4.18 At the conclusion of the interview, including the taking and reading back of any
written statement, the time shall be recorded and the recording shall be stopped. The
interviewer shall seal the master recording with a master recording label and treat it
as an exhibit in accordance with force standing orders. The interviewer shall sign the
label and ask the suspect and any third party present during the interview to sign it. If
the suspect or third party refuse to sign the label an officer of at least inspector rank,
or if not available the custody officer, shall be called into the interview room and asked,
subject to paragraph 2.3, to sign it.
